plugins.name: typescript-lsp
plugins.description: TypeScript/JavaScript LSP that runs one tsserver per project and shares it with every Claude Code session, instead of one per session. Each file is checked with its own project's TypeScript. Works on Windows.

plugins.name: chrome-dev-tools-multitask
plugins.description: chrome-devtools-mcp for many sessions at once: a Chrome window with its own persistent profile per browsing session (sticky per project; hidden on request), no browser server for sessions that never browse, unused browsers closed after 30 minutes. A local debug port and a discovery file per browser let a companion app show a session's page live.
